profile.headline: Sr. Automation Engineer
profile.summary: Experience in PLC programming (Beckhoff, Allen Bradley and Siemens), HMI design (Indusoft, WinCC, TIA portal, Factory Talk), Industrial network connections (EthernetIP, Ethercat, LightBus, Profinet) and Process Automation. I have worked with NiceIncontact and Salesforce for 4 years and have experience and have been trainer for level 1 agents on Mobile computers (PDA, Scanner, forklift), Barcode Scanners (Linear and image) and industrial printers (DT and TTR). Experience with the use of Microsoft office tools. Have good communication and customer service skills.
